integrity: Full proof and standalone Python 3 standard-library checker supplied. Finite checks are corroboration rather than a substitute for the analytical proof. Independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: The independent beta-factor law is proved only for real, identity-matrix least squares, independently drawn rank-one Gaussian sketches, deterministic nonoptimal initialization, and exact arithmetic. No nonlinear, nonidentity, rounding, or runtime result follows.
title: Independent beta contraction factors for Gaussian rank-one randomized CGLS on identity least squares
